from build123d import *

# Main dimensions
main_length = 58.7
collar_length = 21.3
total_length = main_length + collar_length  # 80.0

# Outer diameters

collar_outer_dia = 45.3

collar_body = Pos(main_length + collar_length / 2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(collar_outer_dia / 2, collar_length)
outer = main_body + collar_body

inner_bore = Pos(total_length / 2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(inner_dia / 2, total_length)
part = outer - inner_bore
part.name = "stepped_hollow_cylinder"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
import math

outer_diameter = 80.0
plate_thickness = 6.3
groove_outer_diameter = 70.0
groove_inner_diameter = 65.3
groove_depth = 0.8
central_hole_diameter = 20.2
outer_hole_diameter = 20.2
